chunks: What was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
The ghusl of janabah and hayd is one and the same.

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةِ: the state of major ritual impurity caused by janabah
key_terms.وَاحِدٌ: one and the same in legal form

ai.seo_question: Is the ghusl for janabah different from the ghusl for hayd?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the ghusl performed for janabah and for hayd is of one and the same form. Its significance is in clarifying ritual purity rulings and simplifying the understanding of ghusl in these two states.
